guide.tipBody: Don't wring your hair after applying. Let it air-dry, or use a low-heat dryer.

shampoo.s1Desc: Soak hair and scalp fully with lukewarm water. Avoid hot water.
shampoo.s2Desc: Lather a small amount in your palms and massage the scalp with your fingertips for 2 minutes.
shampoo.s3Desc: Rinse with lukewarm water until nothing is left, then towel-dry gently.

mask.s1Desc: After washing, blot extra water with a towel and apply, leaving 2–3 cm from the roots.
mask.s2Desc: Wait 3–5 minutes so the mask's actives can sink in.
mask.s3Desc: Rinse with lukewarm water until hair feels silky.

oil.s1Desc: Drop 2–3 drops into your palm and warm it between your hands.
oil.s2Desc: Spread evenly through the mid-lengths and ends. Don't put it on the roots.
oil.s3Desc: Comb through, then dry or style as usual.

spray.s1Desc: Shake the bottle and mist evenly from 15–20 cm away.
spray.s2Desc: Work it lightly through the hair with your fingers and wait 2 minutes.
spray.s3Desc: Hair feels soft, shiny, and protected.

faq.q1: How do I top up the wallet?
faq.a1: Go to More → Top up, transfer to the card details, and send the receipt. The balance updates after an admin confirms it.
faq.q2: What's the difference between a transfer and a gift?
faq.a2: A transfer sends money to a friend. If you pick a gift design, an extra fee for the design may be added.
faq.q3: What does freezing the card do?
faq.a3: Outgoing payments (transfers, QR) are blocked for now. You or an admin can unfreeze it at any time.
faq.q4: Where do I see my wallet number?
faq.a4: My card shows the full details and a copy button.
faq.a5: The bonuses section opens soon — for now only the banner is shown.
